name: stjorna-pocketbase-tests
description: Integration tests for STJÓRNA PocketBase backend

scripts.test:sequential: podman volume rm -f stjorna-test-data 2>/dev/null; podman volume create stjorna-test-data 2>/dev/null; for f in auth.test.ts multitenant.test.ts webhooks.test.ts collections/categories.test.ts collections/media.test.ts collections/products.test.ts collections/tenants.test.ts; do echo "Running $f" && podman ps -q --format "{{.ID}}" | xargs -r podman stop 2>/dev/null; npx vitest run "$f" || exit 1; done
